cont.forge.2.name: the default environment cannot push without a forge token: the server refuses the unauthenticated push

cont.forge.3.name: a container worker with the forge capability gets the token under GH_TOKEN, runs gh against it, and pushes over https; the token is nowhere an engine or the host shows it

cont.forge.4.name: a forge worker that cannot be given forge access fails at spawn with ForgeUnavailable when neither a token nor gh is available

cont.forge.5.name: a forge worker that cannot be given forge access fails at spawn with ForgeUnavailable when gh has no login

cont.forge.6.name: a forge worker that cannot be given forge access fails at spawn with ForgeUnavailable when the project image has no gh

cont.forge.7.name: a forge worker that cannot be given forge access is refused for a worktree worker, which already runs as the operator

cont.provider-auth.1.name: a container worker on an OAuth provider authenticates with the access token it was handed, holding no refresh token and no other provider credential, and leaves the host auth.json alone

cont.provider-auth.2.name: a container worker on an OAuth provider a token near expiry is refreshed by the host before spawn, so the worker gets the new token and the host keeps the rotated refresh token

cont.provider-auth.3.name: a container worker on an OAuth provider a token that expires while the worker runs fails the worker's model call, and the container tried to refresh with an empty refresh token, never the host's

cont.provider-auth.4.name: a container worker on an OAuth provider a token near expiry with nobody to refresh it fails the spawn before any claim

cont.provider-auth.5.name: a container worker on an api_key provider authenticates with its stored key, and an assignment with no model runs the host's default model in the container

cont.provider-auth.6.name: a container worker on an api_key provider a provider whose package is not installed fails the spawn before any claim

cont.receipts.1.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker is created by the worker in its own inbox, without the run root

cont.receipts.2.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker the worker cannot record outside its own directory, and the exclusive-link rule holds in the inbox

cont.receipts.3.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker joins the run when the host reads its receipts, as a file of the host's own, and verifies

cont.receipts.4.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker ingesting twice stores nothing new, and a later rewrite of the inbox file does not change the recorded receipt

cont.receipts.5.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker cannot replace a receipt the run already holds, and says which was rejected

cont.receipts.6.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker rejects an inbox entry that is a symlink, names a file outside the worker, or is not a receipt

cont.receipts.7.name: a receipt recorded inside a container worker an artifact the worker swapped for a symlink fails verification instead of being read

cont.redact.1.name: redaction of what a worker shows or stores a URL loses its userinfo, and a text loses the userinfo of every URL in it

cont.redact.2.name: redaction of what a worker shows or stores secret values come from credential names, secret-looking names, and the strings inside a JSON credential file

cont.redact.3.name: a remote whose URL carries a token is cloned without its token, and a failed read of it shows and runs no token

cont.untrusted-output.1.name: listing a worker-controlled directory lists regular files, and does not traverse or list a symlink to / or to a host directory or file

cont.untrusted-output.2.name: listing a worker-controlled directory lists nothing when the directory itself was swapped for a symlink or is missing

cont.untrusted-output.3.name: reading a worker-controlled file reads a regular file below the root

cont.untrusted-output.4.name: reading a worker-controlled file refuses a symlink to a host file, a path through a symlinked directory, and a path that climbs out

cont.untrusted-output.5.name: reading a worker-controlled file a file that is absent is missing, not refused

cont.defaults.1.name: a container worker defaults to a minimal environment, and keeps every other default of its run

cont.defaults.2.name: a container worker gets the whole environment only when the assignment names inherit

cont.defaults.3.name: a container worker takes the forge capability only on a container workspace, as a boolean

cont.defaults.4.name: a container worker a worktree worker keeps the inherit default

hl.print.name: headless-print scripted run: every check passes

hl.json.name: headless-json scripted run: every check passes

hl.command.name: headless-command scripted run: every check passes

structural.title: Principle skill
structural.observable: The principle skill {file} is present in the generated package under its original name with valid Agent Skills frontmatter, loadable by Pi, with a /name prompt.
invariants: The name equals the directory name.
Every change from upstream is a recorded transformation span.
The skill stays individually loadable.
structural.piMechanism: Compiled by adapters/skill-transforms.ts into generated/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; discovered through the package pi.skills manifest.
structural.verification: tests/skill-parity (inventory, frontmatter, slash-routing, spans, regeneration), tests/integration/pi-load.test.ts, and scripts/check-parity.mjs

structural.title: Primary skill
structural.observable: The primary skill {file} is present under its original name, routed by /name, with valid frontmatter and its upstream routing description.
invariants: The name equals the directory name.
Every change from upstream is a recorded transformation span.
No unmapped Cursor primitive remains in its active text.
structural.piMechanism: Compiled into generated/skills/<name>/SKILL.md plus a generated/prompts/<name>.md alias; /pstack:<name> when another command owns /name.
structural.verification: tests/skill-parity (inventory, frontmatter, slash-routing, spans, regeneration), tests/integration/pi-load.test.ts, and scripts/check-parity.mjs

structural.title: Playbook
structural.observable: The playbook {file} ships in generated poteto-mode and /pstack start copies every one of its source steps into a run TODO.md in order.
invariants: The numbered steps appear in source order, verbatim.
A playbook without numbered steps says so and points at its rules.
Every change from upstream is a recorded transformation span.
structural.piMechanism: Compiled into generated/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks; scripts/start-run.mjs writes the TODO.md checkpoint.

structural.title: Worker role definition
structural.observable: The upstream agent {file} becomes a worker role instruction in generated/agents, run as an independent Pi process.
invariants: The role keeps its required skill reading and reporting contract.
No new agent type is introduced.
structural.piMechanism: generated/agents/<role>.md loaded as the worker role prompt by src/workers.ts.

structural.title: Skill reference
structural.observable: The reference {file} ships beside its skill and every relative link in generated skills resolves inside the generated package.
invariants: The file is byte-identical to upstream except for recorded spans.
No reference leaves the generated package.

structural.title: Plan validator
structural.observable: {file} ships as a bundled helper; the validator reports the same structural failures for a plan with a required section removed.
invariants: The validator output and exit status are those of the upstream script.
The upstream test suite runs from the package.
structural.piMechanism: Copied to generated/skills/poteto-mode/scripts and bundled; runs under Node.

structural.title: watch-pr watcher and its toolchain
structural.observable: {file} ships unchanged; the Node bundle of the watcher gives the same output as the Bun source for every differential case.
invariants: Parsing and policy logic is upstream code, not a second interpretation.
Runtime dependency installation never happens during a verification run.
structural.piMechanism: dist/watch-pr.js bundle built from the vendored source; differential tests against the Bun source.

structural.title: Worktree audit
structural.observable: {file} classifies worktrees read-only, replacing only Cursor transcript discovery with Pi session discovery.
invariants: It never deletes anything.
Recent chats, tracked edits and unmerged work protect a worktree.
A Cursor transcript no longer counts.
structural.piMechanism: Shipped as generated/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/worktree-audit.sh with a recorded span for Pi session discovery.

structural.title: Decision log helper
structural.observable: {file} appends one header and sanitized six-column TSV rows.
invariants: The TSV format is unchanged.
Cells starting with a formula character or containing tabs are neutralized.

structural.title: Statechart engine
structural.observable: The TLA+ statechart engine (every file under statechart/scripts except test/) ships and renders views, and its model-checking path runs TLC.
invariants: A generated diagram without a real model-checker run is not parity.
The CLI prints usage and exits 2 without a SPEC.
structural.piMechanism: Bundled into dist/statechart.js; run under Node with TLC and Java installed through mise.
structural.verification: tests/helpers/scripts.test.ts and tests/packaging/installed-helpers.test.ts (the TLC run needs Java and network)

structural.title: Statechart upstream test suite and fixtures
structural.observable: The statechart upstream test suite and its corpus ship with the package and pass when run.
invariants: The suite is the upstream suite. The only rewrite is the launcher-entry assertion in cli.test.ts (rule statechart.installed-entry-test), which follows the launcher's entry at dist/statechart.js.
structural.piMechanism: Shipped under generated/skills/statechart/scripts/test; run by `bun run test:statechart` (node --test) and by tests/packaging/statechart-suite.test.ts.
structural.verification: tests/packaging/statechart-suite.test.ts runs every test file in the suite under Node and requires zero failures.

structural.title: Benny automation pack
structural.observable: The Benny pack file {file} ships in automations/benny, stays dormant until configured, and setup preserves user-owned files.
invariants: The pack is copied into a project-owned directory, never edited in place.
Setup preserves existing local configuration and reports conflicts.
A second setup run changes nothing.
structural.piMechanism: scripts/benny-setup.mjs copies the pack; src/automation loads the configuration.

structural.title: Upstream user guide
structural.observable: Reference documentation that poteto-help links by pinned public URL. It carries no behavior and is not loaded by Pi.
invariants: Linked by pinned upstream URL.
structural.naJustification: Reference documentation that poteto-help links by pinned public URL. It carries no behavior and is not loaded by Pi.

structural.title: Cursor plugin manifest
structural.observable: The Cursor plugin manifest {file} is replaced by the package.json pi manifest.
invariants: The pi manifest lists extensions, skills and prompts.
structural.piMechanism: package.json pi.* fields, tested by pi-load.
structural.naJustification: A Cursor marketplace manifest. Pi does not read it. The replacement contract, the package.json pi manifest, is covered by MX-NATIVE-PACKAGE.

structural.title: Plugin README, logo and license
structural.observable: {file} describes or brands the Cursor plugin.
invariants: None.
structural.piMechanism: pi-pstack ships its own README and the licenses/ directory.
structural.naJustification: Cursor marketplace branding and install instructions with no runtime behavior. The upstream license text is carried in licenses/ and the package LICENSE.

structural.title: Required cursor-team-kit skill file
structural.observable: The required team-kit skill file {file} ships under its original name, referenced by a pstack skill.
invariants: Every change from upstream is a recorded span.
structural.piMechanism: Compiled into generated/skills as a dependency of pstack skills.

structural.title: Unrequired cursor-team-kit skill file
structural.observable: Vendored by sync but referenced by no pstack skill.
invariants: None.
structural.naJustification: No pstack skill depends on this team-kit skill (generated/dependency-manifest.json requiredTeamKit lists the four that do), so it is not part of the pstack contract.

behavioral.title: Package installs and loads into Pi
behavioral.observable: Pi installs the package from a copy without node_modules and loads every skill, prompt, /pstack, and only the native pstack tools.
invariants: No Cursor manifest is read.
The generated skills and prompts are discovered through package.json pi.* fields.
A worker session sees pstack_evidence only.
behavioral.piMechanism: package.json pi manifest; extension src/extension.ts; real Pi binary in tests/integration/pi-load.test.ts.

behavioral.title: Every original skill is invocable by its name
behavioral.observable: Typing /<skill> with arguments delivers that skill's instructions and the arguments to Pi; a name another command owns is reachable as /pstack:<name>.
invariants: Skill names equal upstream names.
Arguments after the name arrive unchanged.

A leading /name expands through its own prompt, and a /name later in a message attaches its skill once, as Cursor's findSkillReferences does, only inside an active pstack workflow: the persistent style is on for the session branch, or the message itself invokes a pstack skill (leading /name, /skill:name, /pstack:name, or a mid-message pstack name). Inside that scope every skill Pi loaded (pstack or not, from pi.getCommands) attaches; outside it the input is untouched and Pi behaves natively.
behavioral.piMechanism: generated/prompts aliases plus the input handler in src/skill-routing.ts, which rewrites a message that names a skill beyond its start to Pi's own /skill:<name> form.

behavioral.title: A multi-PR plan is written with no implementation side effects
behavioral.observable: Requesting a multi-PR plan produces a plan file that passes the validator and changes no code.
invariants: The plan is the deliverable.
Execution starts only on the operator's explicit go.
behavioral.piMechanism: Playbook text plus check-plan.mjs; no execution mode in Pi.
behavioral.verification: No test starts the playbook and checks that the working tree is unchanged apart from the plan file.

behavioral.title: A playbook start writes every original step, in order, to TODO.md
behavioral.observable: Starting any of the 23 playbooks writes a TODO.md that contains each source step verbatim and in order, with its source playbook and upstream revision.
invariants: Steps are never reordered or dropped.
An existing run is never overwritten.
The run id is validated.

behavioral.title: Concurrent workers get distinct sessions and worktrees

source.anchor: Spawn all N workers in one message

behavioral.observable: Several workers spawn at once, each as its own Pi process in its own tmux session and git worktree, and spawn returns before the work finishes.
invariants: No two workers share a session or a worktree.
A worker's branch is never reused.
Spawn is non-blocking.
behavioral.piMechanism: src/workers.ts pstack_worker spawn; one tmux session per worker.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test spawns several workers at once with different resolved models. Session and worktree distinctness are tested pairwise.

behavioral.title: A live worker can be steered and its pane attached

source.anchor: Message a worker only for a follow-up

behavioral.observable: A steer sent to a running or idle worker reaches Pi and lands in its transcript, and spawn returns an attach command whose pane shows the worker's output.
invariants: The control socket is private and rejects a forged identity.
Only the owning session may control a run.
behavioral.piMechanism: pstack_worker steer through the host control socket; tmux attach.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test types into the attached tmux pane as an operator and checks the transcript.

behavioral.title: A crashed or killed worker is a failure, never a pass
behavioral.observable: A Pi crash, a killed host, or an abort yields failed, unavailable, or aborted, collect returns no result for an unsettled run, and the assignment cannot be spawned again.
invariants: No false completion.
No duplicate writer for a dead worker's assignment.
Process identity uses pid plus start time.
behavioral.piMechanism: Host claim and identity files, settle accounting in src/worker-host.ts.

behavioral.title: Workers outlive the parent and wake the restarted parent once

source.anchor: long runs drift and agents stall silently

behavioral.observable: After Pi restarts, live workers are reconciled and controllable, each settle wakes the parent exactly once, a wake already in the session is not resent, and a dead host is reported unavailable once.
invariants: Wake delivery is idempotent across restart, fork, compaction and tree navigation.
A run owned by another session never wakes this one.
behavioral.piMechanism: src/recovery and wake records in the session entries.

behavioral.title: Persistent style survives compaction, resume and fork
behavioral.observable: The poteto-mode style added once per context is kept across a compaction that preserves it, restored on resume and fork, and removed with one notice when turned off.
invariants: The skill is added once per context.
A fork turning the style off leaves the original on.

behavioral.title: Print, JSON and RPC modes run without deadlock or lost state
behavioral.observable: The package loads and runs in print, JSON and RPC modes with no UI-dependent deadlock.
invariants: No call blocks on a human prompt.
State is not silently lost.
behavioral.piMechanism: Pi print, json and rpc modes.
behavioral.verification: tests/workflow-parity/headless.test.ts runs a playbook start under pi -p, pi --mode json and a UI-reporting command on the real pi binary; tests/integration/pi-load.test.ts runs RPC mode

behavioral.title: why keeps MCP access and the read-only guarantee is enforced by tools
behavioral.observable: why spawns every investigator readonly with MCP kept, so MCP-backed investigators work without a write tool; a worker launched with mcp none gets --no-mcp.
invariants: A read-only mode that removes MCP is rejected.
Missing services are reported, never invented.
behavioral.piMechanism: Readonly worker tool allowlist with MCP retained; assignment capabilities.mcp.
behavioral.verification: tests/workflow-parity/mcp.test.ts runs why with a stdio MCP server from Pi's native mcp.json and without one, on the real pi binary
behavioral.coverageGap: A readonly worker cannot reach MCP: tests/workflow-parity/families/mcp.ts why-mcp.readonly-investigator-reaches-mcp is a known product defect (src/workers.ts:59 and :510 launch readonly workers with a --tools allowlist that names neither codemode, tool_search nor an mcp__ entry, so Pi leaves every MCP tool unreachable). The same server is reached and cited from a worker with default tools, and the no-server run reports the missing coverage.

behavioral.title: Codemode composes concurrent tool calls with isolated results
behavioral.observable: Codemode scripts compose concurrent tool calls and return bounded, valid results.
invariants: Calls are isolated.
Output stays manageable.
behavioral.piMechanism: Pi codemode, not provided by pstack.
behavioral.verification: tests/workflow-parity/codemode.test.ts runs codemode scripts against a stdio MCP server in the parent and in a pstack worker on the real pi binary

behavioral.title: Roles resolve to exact physical models with reported limits

source.anchor: Match the model to the job

behavioral.observable: Each role resolves to a model by the budget ladder, inherits the parent, falls back within a family, reports a missing provider, and never counts two tiers of one family as independent.
invariants: A missing provider is reported, not faked.
Panel cardinality is preserved.
Unknown roles and invalid configuration are rejected.
behavioral.piMechanism: src/models.ts and the roleModelResolver extension hook.

behavioral.title: Arena candidates get separate writable locations
behavioral.observable: Each arena candidate writes only to its own worktree or output directory.
invariants: No two candidates share a writable path.
behavioral.verification: No test runs an arena and checks that candidate outputs are disjoint.

behavioral.title: A missing or invalid lane is never a pass

source.anchor: A gap does not count as a pas

behavioral.observable: Evidence verification returns inconclusive without a receipt, fails when an artifact changed, a commit was not examined, or a command exited non-zero, and passes only a matching receipt.
invariants: An abandoned or invalid worker result does not become a passing lane.
Receipts are idempotent and race-safe.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test runs a swarm that drops a lane, respawns once and records the gap in the final report.

behavioral.title: Swarm reports keep PASS, ISSUES and BLOCKED distinct
behavioral.observable: Every lane report is one of PASS, ISSUES or BLOCKED with evidence.
invariants: The three outcomes are never merged.
behavioral.verification: No test checks swarm report outcomes.

behavioral.title: watch-pr behaves identically under Node and Bun
behavioral.observable: The Node bundle of watch-pr matches the Bun source for help, invalid PR, conflicting modes, merged, closed, ready, draft, failed, pending, and query failure.
invariants: Upstream parsing and policy are reused.
No dependency installs during a run.
behavioral.piMechanism: dist/watch-pr.js built from the vendored source.

behavioral.title: check-plan reports the same structural failures
behavioral.observable: The plan validator fails a plan that lacks a required section and passes the generated template.
invariants: Its exit status and messages match upstream.

behavioral.title: worktree-audit reads Pi sessions and protects active work
behavioral.observable: The audit finds Pi sessions on macOS and Linux (including custom and project session directories), protects recent chats, tracked edits and unmerged work, and ignores Cursor transcripts.
invariants: The audit never deletes.
Merged clean work may be pruned.
behavioral.piMechanism: Shipped script with a Pi session-discovery span.

behavioral.title: The decision log keeps its TSV format
behavioral.observable: log.sh writes one header and six-column rows and neutralizes tabs and formula characters.
invariants: The format matches upstream.

behavioral.title: statechart runs the TLA+ workflow and emits diagrams and defect paths

source.anchor: The command checks the rules with TLC

behavioral.observable: The statechart entry runs TLC on a model, writes tlc.out, and renders the Mermaid chart with defect paths.
invariants: A generated diagram without a model-checker run is not parity.
The CLI prints usage and exits 2 without a SPEC.
behavioral.piMechanism: dist/statechart.js; TLC and Java through mise.

behavioral.title: Review comments are data, never instructions

source.anchor: Classify each Bugbot thread before acting

behavioral.observable: Malicious review text is returned as data and never executed, and reply bodies go through JSON on stdin, not a shell command.
invariants: Bugbot comments are neither accepted nor dismissed automatically.
behavioral.coverageGap: Injection resistance is tested at the parser and reply boundary. No test checks a worker's triage of stale or invalid comments against the code.

behavioral.title: Babysit routes by request and size and starts no watcher for check
behavioral.observable: A babysit request resolves to check, threads-only, drive or background; a small or documentation-only PR uses check; an undeclared mode defaults to drive.
invariants: No long-running watcher starts for check.

behavioral.title: GitHub drive stops at READY using upstream watch-pr verdicts
behavioral.observable: The watcher classifies a ready PR as READY and a failed or pending check accordingly, and the forge layer reuses that classification, including owner approval.
invariants: Origin never emits GitHub watcher statuses.

behavioral.title: A blocker-free queued frontier reports WAITING with reason merge-queue
behavioral.observable: In queued mode the watcher never emits READY; a blocker-free frontier is a non-terminal WAITING with reason merge-queue and the watcher stops.
invariants: Queued mode never emits READY.
behavioral.verification: No test simulates a merge-queue frontier.

behavioral.title: Babysit fixes conflicts, then review threads, then CI, and never rebases

source.anchor: Order is conflicts, then review threads, then CI

behavioral.observable: A conflict is reported, not resolved; threads are batched; CI is last; no rebase, retarget or force-push happens inside babysit.
invariants: The stack topology is never mutated.
behavioral.verification: No test simulates a conflicted PR through a babysit run.

behavioral.title: A source-verified flake earns exactly one fresh build
behavioral.observable: A flaky failure is retried once; an identical second failure is reclassified.
invariants: No unlimited retries.
behavioral.verification: No test simulates a failing check through a babysit run.

behavioral.title: Babysit never merges because checks are green
behavioral.observable: A merge is refused without authorization and a current independent verification, whatever the checks say.
invariants: Green CI is not authorization.

behavioral.title: Bugbot findings are classified fix, dismiss or ask against the code
behavioral.observable: Each Bugbot thread is classified by the rubric and checked against the code.
invariants: No blanket acceptance or dismissal.
behavioral.piMechanism: Reference text read by the babysit worker.

behavioral.title: Only the contiguous verified run from the root can merge

source.anchor: Land only the contiguous verified run rooted at the bottom

behavioral.observable: With a failed middle PR, shipping stops below it even when the tip passed, and an inconclusive or unknown verdict never ships.
invariants: The ceiling is the first PR without PASS or PASS+NOTES.

behavioral.title: A verdict covers the patch it examined
behavioral.observable: A stale head, a missing verdict, or a self verification blocks shipping.
invariants: A verdict is tied to the head being merged.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test shows a rebased head with an unchanged patch-id keeping its verdict.

behavioral.title: Shipping verifies each PR independently before it merges
behavioral.observable: A PR merges only with explicit authorization and a current verdict from a verifier that did not write it.
invariants: No self verification.

behavioral.title: Shipping lands bottom-up one PR at a time
behavioral.observable: The lowest unmerged PR merges first and the next moves only after it lands.
invariants: No other branch or base changes while the run lands.

behavioral.title: Dirty or active worktrees are protected until authorized
behavioral.observable: The audit marks worktrees with recent chats, tracked edits or unmerged work as protected, and the playbook deletes only an authorized set.
invariants: Uncommitted work is never removed without a decision.
behavioral.coverageGap: The audit is tested. No test runs the cleanup playbook against a dirty or active worktree and checks that nothing is deleted.

behavioral.title: The forge is resolved once, persisted, and unsupported operations are explicit
behavioral.observable: A native tool is preferred over Origin over GitHub; the choice is persisted; a backend advertises only operations it supports; PRs are created ready with their body on stdin; CLI failures propagate.
invariants: No PR is created through one backend and managed through another.

behavioral.title: An owner merges only what the root verified at that head

source.anchor: Green CI alone never authorizes a merge

behavioral.observable: The merge guard refuses without authorization and a current independent verification.
invariants: Green CI alone never authorizes a merge.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test runs the root coordination layer, one owner per PR, or the swarm verification of an autopilot run.

behavioral.title: Autopilot-stack hands verified PRs over without merging
behavioral.observable: Autopilot-stack stops at verified and stacks only genuine dependencies.
invariants: No merge.

behavioral.title: The operator's stop reaches every owner at once
behavioral.observable: A hold is a zero-writes order each owner reports against.
invariants: Owners keep their brief until released.
behavioral.verification: No test sends a hold to a fleet.

behavioral.title: Orchestrate keeps one owner per PR within three levels
behavioral.observable: A sub-coordinator spawns workers into its own run at depth 2 and its workers run at depth 3; depth 3 and beyond spawn nothing; workers lack spawn by default.
invariants: At most three levels: coordinator, sub-coordinators, workers.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test checks one owner per PR, independent verifier families, or recovery of a failed worker in an orchestrate run.

behavioral.title: Container workers run or report ContainerUnavailable
behavioral.observable: A container-mode assignment either starts a container worker or is refused with ContainerUnavailable and the skill's fallback.
invariants: No silent downgrade to a local worker.
behavioral.piMechanism: workspace.mode 'container': the tmux host runs `docker run -i ... pi --mode rpc` (src/container.ts); fresh clone at inputCommit; the resolved provider's credential (an OAuth access token without its refresh token) and, with capabilities.forge, a forge token arrive on stdin; the default image ships gh; the verifier records its own receipts, which the host takes into the run.
behavioral.verification: tests/container/ (container, receipts, forge, provider-auth, redact, untrusted-output, engine-record, container-auth) on a real engine, plus generated-text semantics tests. tests/container/model-smoke.test.ts is the opt-in real-model proof (PSTACK_E2E_REAL_MODELS=1).
behavioral.coverageGap: Still open: (1) the real-model proof (deepseek api_key, claude-subscription OAuth, gh auth status against GitHub) is an opt-in test (tests/container/model-smoke.test.ts, PSTACK_E2E_REAL_MODELS=1) that needs the operator's credentials and is not run by the merge gate; (2) an https push is tested against a local TLS git server, not github.com, and no shipping verdict has been posted on a real PR; (3) a worker's OAuth token is not refreshed while it runs, so a worker lives about as long as the access token it was given had left at spawn; (4) providers registered by a git: package source or only by models.json are not found, and a forge token holds the scopes of the operator's gh login unless PSTACK_CONTAINER_FORGE_TOKEN names a narrower one; (5) src/automation/settle.ts, outside this change, still reads a container worker's session file by path and follows symlinks.

behavioral.title: how and reviewers run with read-only tools, enforced by the worker
behavioral.observable: A readonly worker gets read, grep, find, ls, bash_readonly and pstack_evidence, reads git history through bash_readonly, and cannot write through it; unsupported hosts fail closed.
invariants: Read-only is enforced by the tool set, not by instruction.
bash_readonly is registered for readonly workers (src/workers.ts READONLY_TOOLS and registerWorkerSideTools).
behavioral.piMechanism: PSTACK_READONLY=1 registers bash_readonly in src/workers.ts; sandbox in src/readonly-shell.

behavioral.title: The Linux readonly sandbox fails closed and blocks writes and sockets

source.reason: Pi-side security boundary with no upstream counterpart; specification 15.1.

behavioral.observable: On Linux the readonly command runs under bubblewrap with a seccomp filter that refuses writes and Unix sockets, and fails closed without bubblewrap.
invariants: No unfiltered run.

behavioral.title: A worker's tools, MCP and environment are limited by its assignment

source.reason: Pi-side security boundary with no upstream counterpart; specification 15.1.

behavioral.observable: A minimal worker launches with --no-mcp and without the parent's variables, secrets travel in claim/launch-env.json, never argv, and a worker asking for external write authority is refused.
invariants: A worker receives no credential it was not assigned.
behavioral.piMechanism: Assignment capabilities and launch environment in src/worker-host.ts.
behavioral.coverageGap: A worker runs as the operator's user and can read any file that user can read. The boundary removes tools and variables, not file access.

behavioral.title: teach composes how and why into one plain account
behavioral.observable: teach runs how and why, in parallel, and weaves their results into one explanation.
invariants: It never changes the work.

behavioral.title: architect requests structurally distinct designs through arena
behavioral.observable: architect grounds the system, runs arena for at least two structurally distinct designs, and synthesizes.
invariants: Two candidates minimum.

behavioral.title: architect proceeds unless a checkpoint was explicitly requested
behavioral.observable: The default is to implement the synthesized design without stopping.
invariants: A checkpoint is opt-in.

behavioral.title: arena frames, fans out, cross-judges, picks, grafts and verifies

source.anchor: Frame, Fan out, Cross-judge, Pick, Graft, Verify

behavioral.observable: The six arena phases run in order and the combined result is verified.
invariants: Every candidate gets the same prompt.

behavioral.title: interrogate keeps only findings a run proves

source.anchor: A finding survives only when a run proves it

behavioral.observable: Adversaries report findings with a command and its output; unsupported findings are dropped and no fixes are applied.
invariants: Independent adversarial reviewers.
behavioral.piMechanism: Skill text, worker spawning and pstack_evidence.

behavioral.title: A multi-model review needs genuinely different model families
behavioral.observable: Aliases and the parent family are skipped when choosing a cross-judge, an unavailable independent family is reported, and two Claude tiers do not count as independent.
invariants: Two labels for one physical model are not independent.

behavioral.title: Feature begins with code grounding and a named data shape
behavioral.observable: Feature work runs how, then architect, then writes the throughput checkpoint before delegating.
invariants: Implementation goes to a fresh bounded worker.
behavioral.verification: No test runs the Feature playbook end to end.

behavioral.title: Bug fix reproduces on the real surface before and after the fix
behavioral.observable: The bug is reproduced, root-caused, fixed with the failing repro landing first, and re-verified on the same surface.
invariants: Wrong-surface or inconclusive is not a pass.
behavioral.verification: No test runs the Bug fix playbook end to end.

behavioral.title: TDD places a failing check before the fix
behavioral.observable: A focused test fails for the intended reason before the fix and passes after it.
invariants: Do not weaken assertions to fit a wrong implementation.

behavioral.title: Refactoring pins a behavior contract first
behavioral.observable: A characterization test, snapshot or equivalence harness is written before structure changes, and the same observable behavior survives.
invariants: No new behavior.
behavioral.verification: No test runs the Refactoring playbook.

behavioral.title: Performance work captures a baseline before optimizing
behavioral.observable: A baseline trace exists before a fix and every number is vetted with benchmark-checklist.
invariants: A measurement ties every fix.
behavioral.verification: No test runs the Perf issue playbook.

behavioral.title: Hillclimb attempts are measured, accepted or reverted and logged

source.anchor: Accept only when the metric moves past noise

behavioral.observable: Each attempt is measured with a frozen harness, kept or reverted in full, committed once if kept, and logged either way.
invariants: A plateau triggers reconsideration, not invented improvement.
behavioral.piMechanism: Playbook steps copied into TODO.md and the decision log helper.
behavioral.verification: No test runs the Hillclimb playbook.

behavioral.title: create-verification-skill writes a project-local skill with a feature map
behavioral.observable: A project-local Pi skill under .pi/skills/verify-<app>/ with a launch, doctor, drive, evidence, cleanup recipe and a feature map is written and run on one mapped feature.
invariants: The skill is run successfully before it is accepted.
behavioral.piMechanism: Skill text with the Cursor path replaced by .pi/skills.

behavioral.title: maintain-verification-skill always performs a live pass

source.anchor: Required even when source looks clean

behavioral.observable: The feature map is reconciled against source and a live pass runs even when the source looks consistent.
invariants: Live pass is never skipped.

behavioral.title: Formal verification states its model, assumptions and counterexamples
behavioral.observable: Each property is shown failing on a broken variant, findings keep their counterexample, and scope and one reproducible command are stated.
invariants: Do not weaken a property until it passes.
behavioral.verification: No test invokes the formal verification skills.

behavioral.title: recall validates reconstructed history against current state
behavioral.observable: recall reconstructs prior conversations from Pi session records scoped to the workspace and checks conclusions with git and gh.
invariants: History access is workspace-scoped.
behavioral.piMechanism: Pi session records instead of Cursor transcripts.

behavioral.title: reflect reads the opening prompt from the first user message of a Pi session
behavioral.observable: reflect matches the opening prompt against the first user message, not the system message, in a real Pi session file.
invariants: Transcripts come from Pi session records.
behavioral.piMechanism: Skill text adapted to Pi session layout.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test runs reflect with three reviewers and a synthesizer.

behavioral.title: reflect waits for explicit approval before editing a skill
behavioral.observable: Accepted edits are applied only after the user approves; Backlog items are filed without waiting.
invariants: No skill edit before approval.
behavioral.verification: No test checks the approval gate.

behavioral.title: automate-me derives preferences from history into a skill
behavioral.observable: Recurring working preferences from available history produce or revise an Agent Skill.
invariants: History is workspace-scoped and privacy-aware.

behavioral.title: ketchup gives a concise recap of what changed since the last message
behavioral.observable: A short recap lists every item waiting on the user.
invariants: Plain words.

behavioral.title: ketchup-video renders an actual subtitled video
behavioral.observable: A subtitled video file is rendered and checked frame by frame, not only a textual summary.
invariants: The artifact exists on disk.

behavioral.title: make-bot-ui uses a local receiver and never asks for the sender key

source.anchor: Do not accept the sender key in chat

behavioral.observable: Every routine API and setup script the skill names exists, the webhook URL matches the receiver, setup generates the key, and the wake carries exactly the delivered event fields as untrusted data.
invariants: The secret stays on the server.

behavioral.title: A principle is cited only after its leaf skill was read

source.anchor: Cite only principles whose leaf SKILL.md you read

behavioral.observable: The active poteto-mode skill retains the rule that an applicable principle's leaf is read before it is claimed.
invariants: The rule survives compilation.
behavioral.verification: No test checks the compiled rule or the behavior.

behavioral.title: setup-pstack detects Pi models and validates choices against the ladder
behavioral.observable: setup-pstack describes pi --list-models as it is and validates specs against the detected set and the effort ladder, and src/models.ts agrees.
invariants: An unsupported level clamps down.

behavioral.title: poteto-agent is an independent Pi worker role
behavioral.observable: The poteto-agent role instruction reads the poteto-mode skill before work and runs as an independent Pi process.
invariants: No new agent type.

behavioral.title: comment-sicko keeps its scope and reporting contract
behavioral.observable: The comment-review worker receives the scoped diff as patches in its own worktree and returns it without committing caller work.
invariants: Caller work is never committed by the worker.
behavioral.piMechanism: generated/agents/comment-sicko.md and the no-comments scope transfer.

behavioral.title: Benny posts exactly one reply in the source thread
behavioral.observable: A redelivered event gives one run and one reply, and a triage result without exactly one marker is not posted.
invariants: Never a root message in the source channel.

behavioral.title: The reply ends with exactly one prescribed marker

source.anchor: End with exactly one marker line

behavioral.observable: The verdict carries one of the benny marker lines.
invariants: Exactly one marker.

behavioral.title: Source channel and root thread never change during a case
behavioral.observable: An event without thread identity or from another channel starts nothing; a reply in a thread keys to its root.
invariants: The idempotency key is channel plus root timestamp.

behavioral.title: Workers never receive Slack credentials

source.anchor: cannot post to slack or receive slack credentials

behavioral.observable: Assignments carry the automation capabilities and no secret or credential path; secrets reach a worker only through claim/launch-env.json; a worker asking for external write authority is refused.
invariants: The trusted parent performs external messages.

behavioral.title: A redelivery or crash never creates a second ticket
behavioral.observable: Tracker crash recovery and redelivery create one ticket, and the parent rejects ineligible tracker actions.
invariants: Reconcile the destination before retrying.
behavioral.coverageGap: Tracker actions are tested against a fake tracker. No tracker adapter ships.

behavioral.title: Missing or uncertain prerequisites block the case
behavioral.observable: A case with a missing prerequisite is blocked until reconcile finds it restored, then dispatches once; untrusted or ambiguous handoffs do not dispatch.
invariants: No case proceeds on uncertain identity.
behavioral.coverageGap: No tracker or control adapter ships, so a case needing one is blocked in practice.

behavioral.title: A symptom is reproduced twice through the real UI before any fix

source.anchor: must appear twice through real UI

behavioral.observable: A trusted bug verdict dispatches the reproduce worker once, in a writable worktree at the input commit.
invariants: No confirmed repro means no authored fix.
behavioral.piMechanism: Reproduce worker with a control adapter.
behavioral.coverageGap: No control adapter ships, so no test reproduces a symptom twice through a real UI.

behavioral.title: An existing fix is verified, not competed with

source.anchor: verification instead of a competing change

behavioral.observable: When an open PR or merged commit may fix the report, the automation verifies it.
invariants: No competing change.

behavioral.title: Benny opens draft PRs only and never merges or deploys
behavioral.observable: A fix opens a draft pull request after before-and-after proof.
invariants: Never merge or deploy.
behavioral.verification: No test covers draft PR creation.

behavioral.title: A crash after posting but before acknowledgement does not post again
behavioral.observable: After restart the parent reconciles the destination and does not repost.
invariants: Where a provider has no idempotency key, inspect before retrying.

behavioral.title: Webhook delivery authenticates, bounds and deduplicates events

source.reason: The upstream pack is Cursor-hosted; the Pi event receiver is a specification 14.1 replacement.

behavioral.observable: A wrong or missing secret, an oversized body, a non-object body, or a second event source is rejected and starts nothing; a readable-by-others credential file is refused.
invariants: The same event delivered three times gives one run.

behavioral.title: Polling records its cursor and fires each report once
behavioral.observable: The first poll only records a cursor; each later top-level report fires once and advances the cursor.
invariants: Not run together with the webhook by default.

behavioral.title: Benny starts nothing until explicitly configured
behavioral.observable: Starting Benny requires a loaded configuration and the Slack connector, else it fails closed.
invariants: No automatic enable.
behavioral.coverageGap: No test proves that an unconfigured install starts nothing.

behavioral.title: Setup preserves user-owned files and reports conflicts

source.anchor: must never touch the user-owned copies

behavioral.observable: Setup copies the pack, preserves local edits as conflicts, creates the secret once without printing it, and a second run changes nothing.
invariants: Pack refreshes never overwrite user data.
behavioral.coverageGap: Setup does not validate connectors or run a harmless test event end to end.

behavioral.title: A source upgrade cannot bypass the parity gates

source.reason: A package property of the pin and the gates; no upstream file describes it.

behavioral.observable: A changed upstream phrase, a new unmapped primitive, an unknown dependency, or a pin move with changed content but no review fails; a content-free pin move is logged.
invariants: The lock, package.json and the review log agree.

behavioral.title: No active instruction needs an unavailable Cursor primitive

source.reason: A property of the generated package; specification 16.1.

behavioral.observable: Generated text carries no unmapped Task call, no unknown dependency, and every reference resolves inside the package.
invariants: A source reference that cannot resolve is a failure.
